posts.subject: Introducing the 35hp knife gamemodes!
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello to the Dream community! 😄 😄 😄


I thought that I would make this post so that everyone gets to have a little bit more fun on our 35hp knife server [^^] . The following gamemodes are explained so that both the community can request it and that knife admins can enforce it. Just request the gamemode in chat, e.g. "Doo Doo! Let's do some Hostage!" but note that as for now, admins are needed to carry out the gamemode until we make some sort of system that will automatically do it @Nachtfrische. Take this as a little guide to have fun! 👍


GAMEMODE: Deathmatch
INSPIRED BY: KermitOS (RIP [bb*] )
RULES: Gangbanging is allowed. Spawn killing is ESPECIALLY not allowed. [neinnein*]
SUMMARY: Simple, every player will get respawned more or less straight after they die. Players are able to simply kill whoever they see so therefore gangbanging is allowed during this gamemode ONLY. However, many people will be scared about losing their points and rank so I advise you to go spectator for that round.
ADMIN NOTES: Allow gangbangs and try to bind a key so that you can respawn all quickly - correct me if I'm wrong but it's something like: bind "key" "say /respawn @all" . Many players usually get tired of this gamemode after 1-2 rounds of excessive respawning. Try to do this game mode on a large map although small maps are feasible too.



GAMEMODE: Legends
INSPIRED BY: Doo Doo 😄
RULES: Normal rule apply. DON'T gangbang the legends and do not move to the legend's team if you are not a legend. [dieregeln*]
SUMMARY: During the first 5 rounds of the new map, tryhard, do your best to be the best on your team! The top (1,2 or 3 players - depending on how many players are on the server e,g, 10 players = 2 legends) will become the 'legend'. If you are a legend, it means that you and your high scoring peers will be moved to a team alone full of legends. As part of the legends team, you will be always at a player disadvantage, which means you need to use your skills displayed earlier to take down the others. As part of the unlucky people who didn't get to become a legend for this time, your aim is to avenge yourself and kill those legends, redeem yourself as worthy and scream "I DESERVED TO BE A LEGEND 🤬 "
ADMIN NOTES: Record the top (1,2 or 3) players on each team and move them towards one team (I usually move them to CT) you can either use the admin menu --> move commands --> move after round-end to move them or simply use the command !swapt or !swapct playername to move them (note that this command will move them without slaying them - anyone know the command to swap them at the end of the round? [^^*] ). Ensure both the legend's and other's safety and dont let them gangbang or be gangbanged. Try to do this game mode on a large map (e.g. 35hp_oldschool, 35hp_$2000$ v2, 35hp_gladiators or even 35_spartans)



GAMEMODE: Hostage
INSPIRED BY: Doo Doo [8)]
RULES: Gangbanging is allowed. [bananenrules*]
SUMMARY: First of all, there will be some sort of mini-game to determine who will be the first 'Hostage' for example, "First one to say 'PewDiePie' in chat will become Hostage!". The first CT and T to say the specified word will get to become the Hostage. The Hostages will be beaconed (a small pulse around a player) to signify their importance and your aim is TO KILL THE ENEMY HOSTAGE [wow] . No matter whatever it takes, kill them, gangbang your way through their defences and go straight for the kill or playing safe and protecting your own Hostage 😇 . The player that kills the FIRST Hostage wins a prize (some credits, usually 100 or 500 - note that this prize will only be for the first round unless admins are feeling generous and rich [cookie*] . After the first round, the admin may choose Hostages at random and the game goes on until players get tired of it or until a new map.
ADMIN NOTES: Think of something to say for the first round of Hostage, of course, try to be sensible. See who wrote it first and check if they are on different teams, if two players say it from T, the first one will become Hostage and look for the first CT so they can become Hostage. Simply beacon the Hostages at the start of the round and enjoy. After the first round, you may pick Hostages at random but try to pick players who are familiar with the gamemode and is regular on the server.


Thank you for reading this short guide and I hope you all try this out 😄
Come and visit 35hp knife server! SERVER IP: 46.105.160.158:26667


EDIT: If you have any ideas for a new gamemode, feel free to comment your ideas! [thanksforit*] 😄

I have been through the hostage and Legends gamemode but my favorite has to be a Hostage [^^] as people sometimes come up with good tactics 😏
But it's the worst part when you're a hostage and you stay against 6 people when gangbanging is allowed [kill*] we need more gamemodes like this, great work doodoo keep it up.


Best Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

*GERMAN*
GAMEMODE: Deathmatch
Erstellt von : KermitOS (RIP [Bild] )
Regeln : Alle dürfen auf eine Person gehen (die Regel 2vs1 fällt außer Kraft). Spawnkilling ist verboten.
Zusammenfassung: Ganz einfach, alle Spieler werden direkt nach ihrem Tot respawn. Man darf nur spiziell in diesem Spielmodus 2 oder mehr gegen 1 machen. Wenn du angst um deine KDR hast, dann gehst du lieber in den Specator Modus.
ADMIN NOTES: Erlaube 2 oder mehr gegen 1 und binde dir den Respawn @all Befehl (bind key "sm_respawn @all" oder bind key "say /respawn @all") - Viele Spieler werden nach 1-2 respawns keine Lust mehr haben, deswegen versucht diesen Spiel Modus nur auf großen Maps zu spielen.


GAMEMODE: Legends
Erstellt von: Doo Doo [Bild] 
Regeln: Normale Regeln. Kein 2vs1, geh nicht in das Legenden Team, wenn du keine Legende bist.
Zusammenfassung: In den ersten 5 Runden einer Map, musst du der Beste sein! Die besten Spieler (1,2 oder 3 Spieler - kommt drauf an wie viele Spieler auf dem Server sind, zb. 10 Spieler = 2 Legenden) werden die Legenden. Wenn du eine Legende bist, wirst du mit den anderen Legenden in ein Team gemovt. Als teil des Legenden Teams, hast du immer einen Nachteil, ihr seid in der Unterzahl! Beweißt euch als Legenden, damit ihr sagen könnt : "ICH HAB ES VERDIENT EINE LEGENDE ZU SEIN".
ADMIN NOTES: Achte auf die Top (1,2 oder 3) Spieler von beiden Teams. Move dann die Top spieler in ein Team und alle anderen Spieler in das andere Team. Achte darauf das beide Teams kein 2vs1 machen. Am besten spielt man den Modus auf großen Maps.


GAMEMODE: Hostage
Erstellt von: Doo Doo [Bild] 
Regeln: Massenschlägerei ist Erlaubt (Holt eure Familie Jungs, eure Brüder, eure Onkels, eure Cousengs).
SUMMARY: Als erstes musst du einen Hostage ausmachen, am besten Stellst du eine Frage oder eine Aufgabe wie zb. "Der erste der "Admin" in den Chat schreibt wird Hostage". Der Hostage Spieler wird gebeaconed. Das Ziel ist es den Hostage Spieler des anderen Teams auszuschalten und natürlich sein eigenen Hostage zu beschützen. Der erste Spieler der einen Hostage killt, bekommt 100-500 Credits von dem Anwesenden Admin.(Je nachdem wie viele Credits der Admin abgeben will) . Nach der Runde, sucht der Admin neue Hostages aus.
ADMIN NOTES: Denkt daran anzumerken in der ersten Runde, worum es geht in diesem Spielmodus. Seid fair wenn es um die Verteilung der Hostage Spieler geht und achtet darauf 2 verschieden Spieler aus verschiedenen Teams zu nehmen.
